narratives.Overview: gjgit is a turnkey Docker Compose stack that provides a self-hosted GitHub mirror and Forgejo git hosting platform deployable in under 5 minutes via a single command. It ships two operating modes — proxy mode (mirrors a GitHub repo/org into Forgejo with caching and acceleration) and standalone mode (plain self-hosted Forgejo with no GitHub dependency) — both controlled by a single .env file. Optimised for high-volume traffic and China-first latency on HK/LA CN2 GIA VPS.
narratives.ProblemStatement: Deploying a self-hosted GitHub mirror or Forgejo instance requires manually integrating multiple services (git hosting, TLS termination, traffic proxying, automated mirroring) with non-obvious wiring and configuration. There is no turnkey solution that works in under 5 minutes, supports dual-mode operation (mirror vs standalone), automates first-run bootstrap including API token generation, and is optimised for high-volume or China-latency scenarios. Developers in China face poor GitHub access; teams need reliable offsite mirrors; solo developers want owned git hosting without managed-service costs.
narratives.Goals: 1. One-command deploy on any VPS or Docker host — docker compose up -d for standalone, docker compose --profile proxy up -d for proxy mode. 2. Proxy/Mirror mode: mirror GitHub repos/orgs into Forgejo with issues, releases, and LFS synced; accelerate git clone/push/pull via ghproxy with hybrid caching. 3. Standalone mode: fully functional Forgejo instance with no GitHub dependency. 4. Automated first-run: env-var-driven admin bootstrap (no manual web UI steps), API token auto-generated and shared with gitea-mirror. 5. Production-ready: automatic HTTPS via Caddy + Let's Encrypt, HTTP/3, Forgejo SSH on configurable port, Prometheus metrics on ghproxy. 6. China-first: excellent latency on HK/LA CN2 GIA VPS, configurable ghproxy cache (up to 20GB+), token rotation support.
narratives.UserStories: US-1: As a developer in China, I want to clone repos via my own domain with low latency so I can work without VPN interruptions. US-2: As a team lead, I want to mirror a GitHub org into my Forgejo instance with issues and releases synced so my team has a reliable, fast backup. US-3: As a solo developer, I want a self-hosted GitHub alternative I can deploy in 5 minutes so I own my code without paying for managed hosting. US-4: As a DevOps engineer, I want Prometheus metrics on proxy traffic so I can monitor load, tune cache sizes, and plan capacity.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: Two operating modes via MODE env var — proxy (caddy + forgejo + gitea-mirror + ghproxy) and standalone (caddy + forgejo). FR-2: Docker Compose profiles — proxy profile activates gitea-mirror and ghproxy; base profile activates caddy and forgejo only. FR-3: Automatic HTTPS and HTTP/3 via Caddy v2 + Let's Encrypt; LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL configurable. FR-4: Forgejo SSH exposed directly on a configurable host port (default 2222). FR-5: Entrypoint bootstrap script reads GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME / GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD / GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL from .env, creates admin user via Forgejo CLI on first boot (idempotent — skips if user already exists). FR-6: Bootstrap script generates a Forgejo API token and writes it to a named Docker volume shared with gitea-mirror, eliminating the manual token step. FR-7: gitea-mirror syncs repos, issues/PRs-as-issues, releases, and LFS on a configurable interval (default 15m) from GITHUB_REPO / GITHUB_TOKEN. FR-8: ghproxy (wjqserver/ghproxy) provides hybrid memory+disk caching, rate limiting, and Prometheus metrics on port 9090; cache size and RPS configurable via .env. FR-9: Caddyfile routes web traffic (/, /user*, /explore*, /api*) to Forgejo; in proxy mode git/raw/release paths additionally served via ghproxy. FR-10: .env.example documents every required and optional variable with inline comments. FR-11: Shell bootstrap and utility scripts tested via bats-core; docker compose integration tests assert HTTP 200 on Forgejo health endpoint and ghproxy status endpoint after stack start. NFR-1: Cold deploy (docker compose pull + up) completes and serves HTTPS within 5 minutes on a VPS with Docker pre-installed. NFR-2: ghproxy cache size configurable to 20GB+; supports HK/LA CN2 GIA VPS network topology. NFR-3: Test coverage >= 85% for all shell scripts (bats-core) and integration assertions. NFR-4: No secrets committed — all credentials via .env (gitignored); secrets/ dir holds .example templates only. NFR-5: All config files have .example counterparts committed to the repo.
narratives.SuccessMetrics: 1. Fresh deploy completes with valid HTTPS cert in under 5 minutes on a standard VPS. 2. git clone https://git.yourdomain.ai/owner/repo.git works without errors in proxy mode. 3. gh CLI commands (gh repo clone, gh issue list) work against the mirror endpoint. 4. Forgejo web UI shows mirrored issues and releases within one mirror interval. 5. ghproxy Prometheus metrics accessible at :9090/metrics. 6. bats-core unit tests and docker compose integration tests pass in CI. 7. Stack restarts cleanly after reboot with no manual intervention (restart: unless-stopped on all services).
narratives.Architecture: Single Docker bridge network gjgit. Services: (1) caddy (caddy:2-alpine) — TLS termination, HTTP/3, reverse proxy. Routes all web paths to forgejo:3000; in proxy mode additionally routes git/raw/release paths to ghproxy:8080. Mounts Caddyfile and caddy_data volume. (2) forgejo (codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:14) — git hosting, web UI, SSH on host port 2222. Custom Docker entrypoint wraps the official image: on first boot runs forgejo admin user create from GITEA_ADMIN_* env vars (idempotent), then calls the Forgejo token API to generate a named token and writes it to /shared/forgejo-token (shared Docker volume). (3) gitea-mirror (ghcr.io/raylabshq/gitea-mirror:latest, proxy profile) — reads /shared/forgejo-token at startup, connects to Forgejo API, and syncs GITHUB_REPO on MIRROR_INTERVAL cadence with issues, releases, and LFS enabled. (4) ghproxy (wjqserver/ghproxy, proxy profile) — GitHub resource reverse proxy with hybrid cache (GH_PROXY_CACHE_SIZE), rate limiting (GH_PROXY_RATE_LIMIT_RPS), and Prometheus on :9090. (5) bootstrap (one-shot init container, runs to completion before forgejo healthcheck passes) — handles admin creation and token generation; forgejo and gitea-mirror depend_on bootstrap. Mode switching: standalone = docker compose up -d (no profile); proxy = docker compose --profile proxy up -d.
